info.title: Ritucast Agricultural Intelligence API
info.description: Evidence-based agricultural intelligence and decision-support API for Bangladesh. Exposes validated observations (Tier 1), physical indicators (Tier 2), probabilistic forecasts (Tier 3), and actionable agronomic recommendations (Tier 4) for pilot testbeds in High Barind Tract (Rajshahi) and Haor Basin (Sylhet).

get.description: Verify that the FastAPI application process is running and accepting HTTP requests.
Verify that required Phase 8 processed Parquet tables and analytical dependencies are ready.
Retrieve list of authorized pilot Upazilas in High Barind Tract and Haor Basin with centroid coordinates.

get.summary: Retrieve Tier 1 observations and Tier 3 probabilistic forecasts for an Upazila
get.description: Returns empirical meteorological observations (Tier 1: NASA POWER / BMD station) and numerical weather prediction forecasts (Tier 3: ECMWF IFS / NOAA GFS) for the specified Upazila.

get.summary: Calculate Tier 2 FAO-56 Reference ET0 and Root-Zone Water Deficit
get.description: Calculates Penman-Monteith ET0, calibrated crop evapotranspiration (ETc), and daily root-zone water depletion (Dt) with AWD thresholds for the given Upazila, crop, and stage.

get.summary: Calculate Tier 2 Haor Flash Flood Hazard Index (I_flood)
get.description: Computes the normalized flash flood hazard index (I_flood) combining transboundary Meghalaya catchment rainfall, Surma river stage elevation, rate of rise, and SAR inundation fraction.

get.summary: Retrieve context-gated 4-tier agricultural advisory for an Upazila
get.description: Primary decision-support endpoint evaluating active Phase 9 scientific rules (irrigation postponement, moisture deficit alert, Haor early harvest, thermal stress). Strictly gated by Upazila, Crop, and Phenological Stage (DEC-17).

post.summary: Evaluate custom scenario through the Phase 9 recommendation engine
post.description: Allows direct evaluation of advisory rules with custom environmental inputs, data timestamps, or ensemble spread metrics.

post.summary: Evaluate physical agricultural hazards without uncalibrated probabilities
post.description: Evaluates environmental hazard thresholds (soil moisture deficit, Haor flash flood, cold/heat stress) using physical observations and scientific criteria. Strictly adheres to DEC-06: does not provide uncalibrated crop failure probabilities.
